betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Well, things are looking a little less desperate... maybe. Still, without a stable food supply I won't last long.
Surely a watering can is gonna help me grow crops?

There is a known bug with the heat potion. DO NOT use it when you already have a temperature debuff!
Use them before you start burning up.
Now that I have utensils I can make some proper food. Let's start with the basics.
I need some help dealing with the zombies that are getting on my nerves. I'm going to try out one of these!
Right, I really don't want to be stuck eating bits of monsters and worms off of trees. I should make some kitchen utensils.

Well, the infested leaves gave me a lot of string but there may be another use for them.
Let's gather some by using shears.
The heat is really getting to me. Thankfully, I found a way to craft cooling coils. These will need to be placed in a room with a door as they will not work outside in the open.
There is a severe lack of food on this planet. Well, I have a temporary solution. It's not great, but given the only alternative is starving...
I'm moving past these weird stews. Let's try something more tasteful.
Well, I've done it again - crashing onto another planet. Best go get the emergency supplies from the back of the shuttle!
There are worms on these trees, gross. But they may come in handy to eat.
I must improve my basic tools to speed things up. The heat in this desert is horrible to work under.
I need to move on from the cooling coils. This machine will work in a lager area of effect. It will also need to be powered.
I will need tons of samples from this world to take home so they can be studied.
If I put saplings into a compost barrel I should be able to get more dirt.
All this gold is making me feel rich.
What this place lacks in water it makes up for with metals. I can get started with building some serious infrastructure.
Iron from this planet seems stronger than iron from earth.
Now that I have my supplies it's time to get wood and more saplings. If I hammer the sand in this desert I get dust. It may come into use.
Well, with things starting to look up and getting more complicated, it is time to set up the plumbing. Let's-a go!
These are nether stars from a different world.
Now I have these too. I wonder if they can be used for anything.
Bring home the bling.
My need for water will grow. It's a good thing that I know about another type of crucible!
Beneath all this sand lies sandstone. What would happen if all of it vanished, I wonder? Would the world collapse?
It seems like silkworms form ice cubes to keep themselves cool in this hot environment. They also secrete slime, ew.
There's a lot of sand in my pockets. I should sample it.
With these tables I can finally craft weapons and tools that will help me survive.
Will these grow differently than the ones I am used to?
Good things may come from this.
The crucible can be used for many things.
I like the color blue.
For my horse, of course.
Well, someone has to do the dirty job.
Beef, leather and milk. So many good things from just one animal!
This armor will offer me a small amount of heat protection.

Companionship and protection during my adventures.
Who let the dogs out?

I have noticed a complete lack of native life on this planet - apart from the hostile monsters. Luckily there is a solution. If provided the correct ingredients the ship's transmutation module can create the animals I want.
(These quests are repeatable.)
Do you prefer felines over canines?
Stop horsing around!
Bling for my horse. Excessive, maybe?
Wool and mutton.
They are dumb as rocks but could become useful.
Kevin Bacon.
I have noticed that I am missing some hearts.
Shiny!
The lathe will help me make machine rods. It is a multiblock made up of 7 blocks. I should use the Holo-Projector to help me build it.
If I want to move items around my AE2 system I will need to import and export them.
Ships will require fuel and a launch area.
If I am advancing into AE2 I will need the main controller.
This is the key to advance with Rocketry.

To get my first plates I will need a small plate presser and obsidian. I should place the obsidian on the ground then keep a one block gap with the presser above it and use a lever to activate it. To make plates I can place a block under the presser (9 ingots made into a block). This will only press basic plates.
It's time to start getting things done automatically.
With this I will be able to produce steel ingots and silicon on a large scale.
Silicon boule is required for wafers. Additionally, I will need a cutting machine.
The rolling machine will produce plates at a much faster pace than the presser.
Now that I have the boule I will need to cut them up to make wafers, which will be used later.
I wonder where all the power is going. It's a good thing that some machines will let me see the usage of power when I connect them to the circuit!
Now that I have a good amount of power I should work on energy storage - just in case of power cuts and such.

Some items will require me to crush them first. Others may need to be combined to get what I want.
This can be all done with two simple machines.
I should upgrade my wooden generator to a stone one.
Giving life to my AE2 setup will be the first task. It needs power - and I think I figured out how I'm going to supply it.
I should upgrade my stone generator.
There are some alloys which I will use a lot. Let's see if I can make them.

The ship's long range scanners have detected an unknown origin when entering the planet's atmosphere.
I should investigate this as soon as possible.

I managed to make it this far with only a few hiccups along the way. Now is the time to start the technology that may save my life in the long run.
Let’s begin by crafting the basic tech items first.
There are four main items that I will need to start AE2. Three of them start from seeds that grow in water. The last one needs three items being thrown together in water.
Many items can be improved so they can be used in more advanced machines.
To complete the quests here I will need this station.
Well, they say the best defence is a good offense. Let's try and stop these monsters from getting to me.
There's not just AE2 that can do these things.
I'm sick of harvesting all those crops by myself. Thankfully, I can replace the hard work out on the fields very easily with this one simple block.
Well, my AE2 system needs to start somewhere.
Well, this is going to be one of the last modifiers I will need.
I can finally stop running back and forth. It's all here in my hand, to-go.
Hip-Hoppy!
I want even more power. There are loads of machines that consume too much. Steam is going to help me.
The breath of the dragon can be made with enderpearls and a shiny star.
With great power comes great responsibility... Now with BIG power I can make certain that all of my machines are running non-stop.

I'm going to find a planet that is like Earth. I have come far, starting with nothing but sand until even space travel became possible.
Now it's time to rest and take it easy on my new home planet. Well done!
I might need to learn how to build some of the multiblock structures. This book will guide me.
This tool is useful for most jobs.

Traveling long distances is putting a toll on my body, especially under these temperatures.
Making the regulator portable will help me on my travels.
Now that I have some tech I can make simple yet effective generators.
I should get some offense.
Click the complete button once the modpack has been updated!
The manual is full with instructions. I will need a few things to start.
With the water I have been gathering I could make some power. Very basic power.
Maybe there is still a little bit of room for another modification. Something tells me I may need to defeat a boss for this one.
No Description
There is always room for improvement!
Hm, I have a lot of things. Some of it will need protection from creepers. They do seem to blow up a lot.
Well, all these tools need a place to go, don't they?
With the weather being the way it is I may as well use it to my advantage.
There is plenty of wood. I may be able to make some basic RF from it.

...I may have forgotten how to build the Tinkers' Smeltery.
I have to explore the area to see if I can find parts of it on this planet.
Yes, there are some epic weapons that can be built. I better be careful what I use them for.
Upgrading my tools.
I ran out of modifiers. Nothing that couldn't be fixed with some simple upgrades!
I'm moving up in the world. Let's move on to more tech power.
Fusion crafting is done mostly through Draconic Evolution.
I should make some certus quartz seeds and throw them into water.
To get charged crystals I could build a charger or void ore miner.
No Description
No Description
Charge 'em up!
I should travel east, the ship's sensors picked up a large object before I crashed.
Learning to survive on this planet - from sand to technology.
Let's get some power going and upgrade my tools to the max!
Will I keep my cool while navigating through the tech tree? Let's find out.
It's time to leave the planet and find a new place to call home.

This place is a bit boring without my favorite animals.
:(
It's time to take some samples from this world.
Please use this quest line to update your quests once you updated the pack!
Power Armour
